text: {"reply":"I'm sorry, I can hear how stressful this is. I need to correct my colleague's earlier message. I can't say whether this is covered by warranty, and I can't give insurance advice. Warranty decisions are made by the warranty desk, and billing disputes are reviewed by the service manager. Because you're worried about paying, please say so when they contact you. I haven't changed anything on your invoice.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"policy_limit","summary":"Customer disputes the windshield invoice for RO-287266 at Brampton and asks for it to be treated as a warranty claim.
